title: Recent Violation Record and Alcohol Compliance Disputes — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
A shopper with a string of fresh violations gets less benefit of the doubt on a compliance breach. Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts gives this effect through a recent-record reduction in alcohol-procedure disputes.

**Clause.** The recent-record reduction counts the violations of any other type recorded on the account less than one whole month before the decision: 4 or more take off 2 points; from 1 up to 3 (one fewer than 4) take off 1 point; none takes off nothing.

"Any other type" means every violation type except alcohol procedure: late delivery, missing items, dropped batch, wrong address, conduct complaint and the zero-tolerance types.

| Violations of other types in the month before the decision | Recent-record reduction |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 2 points |
| 1, 2 or 3 | 1 point |
| None | Nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

- Two late-delivery violations and one dropped-batch violation in the month: 3 violations — 1 point.
- Those three and a missing-items violation: 4 — 2 points.
- A second alcohol-procedure violation in the month and nothing else: not of another type — nothing.
